frozen_at: 2026-10-18, before any simulation result was computed

data.price_series: server/research_scripts/phase7/phase7_9h/raw_data/nxs_d1_gold_phase79h.csv (discovery, already exposed in Phase 7.27; never modified)
data.regime: phase7_27/nxs_regime_classifier.build_regime_table (causal SMA50 slope x ATR14 tercile, as 7.27)
trade_distributions: phase7_9k BREAKOUT_ACC opened events net R (n=47, via phase7_21 loader)
phase7_24 LIQ_SWEEP closed events net R (n=42, via phase7_25 loader)

edge_injection: Additive shift delta applied ONLY to an in-memory copy of event outcomes (signal layer: h10 forward return in ATR14 units; trade layer: net R). Prices and datasets untouched.

signal_layer.eligible_bars: regime known (no UNKNOWN) and h10 available

generators.G_U: n bars uniform without replacement, sorted by time
generators.G_C: clustered: n/4 cluster centres uniform, events at centre+{0,2,4,6} bars (overlapping h10 windows = serial dependence)
generators.G_B: beta-only: n bars uniform among sma50_slope==UP bars, delta=0 (directional exposure, no selection skill)

signal_layer.control: one regime-matched random bar per event (same sma50_slope x vol_tercile, != event), as 7.27 REGIME_MATCHED_RANDOM_LONG
signal_layer.cost_note: 0.5$ and 2.0$ round trip (phase7_21 COST_MODERATE/COST_STRESS) divided by median ATR14 26.9$; cost grid run only at n in {47,200}, delta in {0,0.25,0.5}

methods.M1: Phase 7.27 primary: IID percentile bootstrap of paired diffs, 95% CI excludes 0 (B=2000 vectorized; 7.27 used 10000)
methods.M_UNC: beta-confusion check: one-sample IID bootstrap of y_event - mean(all eligible y) (7.27 UNCONDITIONAL_LONG_EXPOSURE), G_B only

trade_layer.base: real net R recentred to mean 0 (H0), then +deltaR - costR; IID resampling of n trades
trade_layer.cost_note: 0.5$ / 2.0$ over BREAKOUT_ACC median risk 25.2$; cost grid run on BREAKOUT_ACC only
trade_layer.method: IID percentile bootstrap 95% CI on mean R (as 7.21/7.25 statistical_uncertainty); success = CI lower bound > 0

screening_vs_confirmation.screen: two-sided IID bootstrap p (B=2000) -> engine.multiple_testing_v2.benjamini_hochberg q=0.10, positive mean required
screening_vs_confirmation.confirm: fresh independent sample of same n, CI lower bound > 0

success_criteria.calibration: type I in [0.025, 0.075] (MC SE ~1.1% at 400 reps) for M1..M4 under G_U and G_C at delta=0; M1 CI coverage of true E[d] in [0.92, 0.98] under G_U
success_criteria.beta_discrimination: under G_B, regime-matched methods keep type I <= 0.075 while M_UNC is expected to reject
success_criteria.economically_relevant: trade layer deltaR in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3}; signal layer delta in {0.25, 0.5} ATR

decision_rule.PIPELINE_MIS_CALIBRATED: M1 (method used in past decisions) type I > 0.075 under G_U, or coverage < 0.90, and no calibrated dependence-aware alternative exists in the engine
decision_rule.PIPELINE_UNDERPOWERED: calibrated, but power < 0.80 for every economically relevant delta at realistic n
decision_rule.PIPELINE_CAPABLE: calibrated and power >= 0.80 for deltaR = 0.2 at n <= 50
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: Monte Carlo uncertainty or missing data prevents classification
decision_rule.note: if M1 is miscalibrated only under G_C while M2-M4 are calibrated, report as a scoped calibration defect, not a pipeline-wide verdict
